answer: An economy resists Sybil attacks by weighting each identity by the age of its locked stake. A new key is an empty walnut: it earns no voice until its bond cures through a full tide of epochs. Attestations are minted at a forge that refuses to stamp any key whose stake was deposited this season, so freshly funded clones cast nothing. To make them count, an attacker must fund and hold a bond per clone through maturation, and any duplicate vote slashes the whole cohort. The cost is capital frozen for a season per fake seat, paid up front with no early exit.
